push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 10.0 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, that 10.0 is the kind of night that makes an old coach believe in magic. Top 10% of forwards.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. Smart picks beat big swings.
+ 2 goals from 2 on target. You made the hard part look like a Sunday stroll.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic. That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. Put that one on the fridge.

WORK ON
- 71% passing (20 of 28). When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Shots: 2. That's a B. The A-students among forwards are at 3+.

This week's homework: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.9 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
A 9.9 against WhoDisBic, BellyTb1. If I had a hat I'd tip it, then I'd buy a second hat just to tip that one too.

DID WELL
+ 100% passing on 22 attempts, up from your usual 77%. You kept that ball like it owed you money.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ 1 key pass. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ 2.0 better than your average. You're trending like a cat video.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- Passes attempted: 22. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 25+ is something else.

Back-garden drill: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

Believe. And maybe stretch. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Defensive work rate
strengths.note: Puts in the defensive work and engages the ball carrier.
strengths.coach: You put your foot in and did the dirty work. That doesn't make highlight reels, but it wins matches.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 61% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Won 2 of 9 tackles (22%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.1 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
Well, butter my biscuit, tuxedo_slide. A 9.1. Folks in the top 10% of midfielders don't play much better than that.

DID WELL
+ 9 tackles attempted (up from your usual 2). You chased like a golden retriever after a tennis ball, and I mean that as a compliment.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 1 key pass. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 1.6 over your norm. Keep stacking days like this.

WORK ON
- 61% passing (11 of 18). Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
- Won 2 of 9 tackles. Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
- Passes attempted: 18. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 25+. That's the next rung.

Coach's drill: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

That's the kind of night that makes me glad I took this job. - Coach Lasso
